Classes

AccessModifierNotAllowedForCachedValueException

Occurs when attempting to cache a non-private and non-readonly field with an attached osu.Framework.Allocation.CachedAttribute.

AccessModifierNotAllowedForLoaderMethodException

Occurs when a method with an attached osu.Framework.Allocation.BackgroundDependencyLoaderAttribute isn't private.

AccessModifierNotAllowedForMemberException

Occurs when a dependency-related operation occurred on a member with an unacceptable access modifier.

AccessModifierNotAllowedForPropertySetterException

Occurs when the setter of a property with an attached osu.Framework.Allocation.ResolvedAttribute isn't private.

BackgroundDependencyLoaderAttribute

Marks a method as the (potentially asynchronous) initialization method of a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable, allowing for automatic injection of dependencies via the parameters of the method.

CachedAttribute

An attribute that may be attached to a class, interface, field, or property definitions of a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable to indicate that the value should be cached as a dependency. Cached values may be resolved through osu.Framework.Allocation.BackgroundDependencyLoaderAttribute or osu.Framework.Allocation.ResolvedAttribute.

CachedModelDependencyContainer<TModel>

A osu.Framework.Allocation.DependencyContainer which caches a TModel and members it contains attached with a osu.Framework.Allocation.CachedAttribute as dependencies.

DependencyContainer

Hierarchically caches dependencies and can inject those automatically into types registered for dependency injection.

DependencyNotRegisteredException

Occurs when an object requests the resolution of a dependency, but the dependency doesn't exist. This is caused by the dependency not being registered by parent osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable through osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.CreateChildDependencies(osu.Framework.Allocation.IReadOnlyDependencyContainer) or osu.Framework.Allocation.CachedAttribute.

InvokeOnDisposal

Instances of this class capture an action for later cleanup. When a method returns an instance of this class, the appropriate usage is:

using (SomeMethod())
    {
        // ...
    }

The using block will automatically dispose the returned instance, doing the necessary cleanup work.

LongRunningLoadAttribute

Denotes a component which performs long-running tasks in its osu.Framework.Allocation.BackgroundDependencyLoaderAttribute method that are not CPU intensive. Long-running tasks are scheduled into a lower priority thread pool.

MultipleDependencyLoaderMethodsException

Occurs when multiple osu.Framework.Allocation.BackgroundDependencyLoaderAttributes exist in one object.

NullDependencyException

The exception that is thrown when attempting to cache null using osu.Framework.Allocation.CachedAttribute.

ReadOnlyDependencyContainerExtensions

ResolvedAttribute

An attribute that is attached to properties of a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable component to indicate that the value of the property should be retrieved from a dependency cache. Properties marked with this attribute must be private and have a setter.

TimedExpiryCache<TKey, TValue>

A key-value store which supports cleaning up items after a specified expiry time.
